hosting_cloud_web_migration_modal_intro_: Confirm the migration of your Cloud Web plan
As part of the evolution of our plans, your Cloud Web plan will soon move to our new Performance plan.
This migration is scheduled from October 2026. The exact date will be sent to you later by email.
Do you accept this automatic migration?
hosting_cloud_web_migration_modal_accept: You have accepted the automatic migration.
We will get back to you by email to inform you of the migration date of your service and its options.
hosting_cloud_web_migration_modal_refuse: You have refused the automatic migration.
Your Cloud Web service will be shut down at the end of November 2026.
If you are eligible for a refund, the corresponding amount will be refunded to you automatically.
Remember to retrieve your files and data before your service is shut down. After that date, any data that has not been retrieved will be permanently deleted.
